exact.description: C2 exactly as measured at gate v235/v238: 4 users x 131072-token context, 256-token output budget

c2.description: C2-any (plan stage S1, internal): the exact geometry (131328 positions, 2052-page tables, 8208 KV blocks = 4 x 2052) serving ANY request the edge admits. QWEN_FAST_ANY_REQUEST=1 builds one engine per request, with no packed block beside it, without replay attention and the per-request T16 gate (their captures are 1, 2 and 4 rows, which never replay), runs the gate's source qualification once at attach, gives each request its own max_tokens as its budget, and ends a host-side refusal of one request's own terms (its sampling contract, budget or page table) as that request's FINISHED_ABORTED instead of the engine's death; every other refusal still fails the engine. Output ceiling 16384; prompts up to 123136, so every admitted prompt keeps at least 8192 tokens of answer room; max_tokens 8192 when the client omits it. An omitted max_tokens is recognised as vLLM fills it (0.25.1 get_max_tokens: the whole remaining context, max_model_len - prompt), so an EXPLICIT max_tokens of exactly max_model_len - prompt reads as omitted and also gets 8192; ask for any other value to get the clamp instead. Decode is 4-row sequential, and no packed block is built (QWEN_FAST_PACKED_STEP=0): it needs every live user inside [131072, 131328), which the 123136-token prompt cap never reaches, and it held 3.84 GB per chip that four per-request engines need (run 36218104858 ran out of DRAM building the fourth). The padded block goes with it (QWEN_FAST_PADDED_BLOCK=0); the single gate/up copy stays, admitted because no verify reaches 16 rows (serving_runtime.c2_any_without_block). UNVERIFIED on hardware: per-request decode more than 256 positions past its capture (every budget served so far was <= 256), and the proposal ladder a short prompt builds at a long budget (up to four buckets per user, R3). Not qualified for production traffic.

c2-gate.description: GATE ONLY (the c2 bring-up at v235's shape): c2's environment - QWEN_FAST_ANY_REQUEST=1, output ceiling 16384 - with exact's prompt limit, 131072 (min_answer_tokens 256, no max_prompt_tokens), so the 4 x 131072 real-text bring-up runs c2's code where v235 ran and compares byte for byte: at 131072 every request's budget is min(max_tokens, 256), and the four-user packed block engages beside the Phase 0 engines. The engine argv is exact's. Not for traffic: a 131072-token prompt leaves 256 tokens of answer.

c2-packed.description: C2-packed-any (plan stage S2): c2 WITH the 64-row packed block, serving it at any position. c2's environment less its two block overrides (QWEN_FAST_PACKED_STEP=0, QWEN_FAST_PADDED_BLOCK=0), so the image's QWEN_FAST_PACKED_STEP=1 and QWEN_FAST_PADDED_BLOCK=1 build the block, plus QWEN_FAST_EXTENT_REPLAY=1: each packed user reads its own 256-key family E = (start // 256 + 1) * 256 through one K64j 0x27 program per bundle (graft K64j, flag 0x20, a per-bundle cur_pos tensor), so 2-4 live users at any positions >= 128 share one verify round instead of 4-row sequential rounds. c2's limits: prompts up to 123136 (at least 8192 tokens of answer room), output ceiling 16384, max_tokens 8192 when omitted, parser M. The attach is refused unless packed_any_admission admits it (the M3 shape, eight-row groups, the tree-scratch patch, K64j at both binary paths with its kernels, and packed_any_evidence.json recording CB1, CB2a and CB2b PASS); a refused attach fails closed and c2 keeps serving. NOT QUALIFIED for traffic until the S2 gates (design 6.3, M0-M12) pass.

c2-packed-gate.description: GATE ONLY (S2's flag-on arms, G3/G3b/M1): c2-gate plus QWEN_FAST_EXTENT_REPLAY=1 - c2-gate's environment, engine and limits (no prompt cap, min_answer_tokens 256, so 4 x 131072 runs where v235 ran), with the packed block serving through the K64j extent readers. Its flag-off twin is c2-gate. Not for traffic: a 131072-token prompt leaves 256 tokens of answer.

c2-packed-tp4.description: C2-packed-any at TP4 (plan S2-TP4), the TRAFFIC profile and the image default: the c2-packed stack on all four cards as one (1, 4) mesh (mesh_device P150x4, QWEN_FAST_TP=4): the four-card ring descriptor at two links (tp4_mesh: 2x2), FABRIC_1D with the model's own Ring collectives, the fast path's own collectives at Linear (QWEN_FAST_CCL_TOPOLOGY, mesh_link_policy), QWEN_PROJECTION_LINKS=2 (two trained links per edge), the K64j extent program at ONE KV head per chip (QWEN_FAST_SDPA_MODES=tail,share: 0x23; the q-slice needs a second KV head) at G8B2, the packed GDN launch at 12 value heads on 48 cores, and no on-device sampler: the fast path verifies with its own shard argmax over 62,080 columns per chip (248,320 / 4). Drafting is the PAIR fold at 8 / 2 heads (QWEN_FAST_QUAD_DRAFT=0), and the drafter's K/V publication is the four-card slide (QWEN_FAST_TP_KV_SLIDE=1, draft_kv_slide_tp: the pair's kernel over 2 KV heads on 8 workers per chip; the six-op eager chain stays behind the flag as the reference). Switched OFF because their code carries the pair's chip or head literals: the quad draft, the fused commit and its in-place / live-bank variants, the pair's draft K/V slide experiment, the traced publish's K/V fusion, the MLP block stream, the GDN direct-window and shared-QK experiments. The bring-up switches are general-tp4's: the fused prefill matmul + reduce-scatter off, the exact prefill conv audited beside the FIR for the first four chunks (raises on a byte difference). SERVED WITH BOTH VERIFY AUDITS OFF (QWEN_FAST_VERIFY_T1_AUDIT=0, QWEN_FAST_VERIFY_T2_AUDIT=0) AND THE PINNED SAMPLER RECORDED IN THE VERIFY TRACE (QWEN_FAST_PACKED_SAMPLER_IN_TRACE=1): the verified winning recipe. Until now the profile carried both audits on because with them off the traffic profile hung twice at the first four-user answers' tail (the platform replay SR v163 and the direct smoke SS v164: the host blocked in ttnn.execute_trace on the first replay of a request's rows=2 verify trace after many four-user packed rounds). The factorial showed the T1 audit alone passes every hang shape, the T2 audit alone hangs and both off hangs; the T1 audit's effect is the pinned sampler's ops inside the verify trace, and QWEN_FAST_PACKED_SAMPLER_IN_TRACE=1 records exactly those ops without the per-round readback and compare, so the audits-off path keeps the trace shape that does not hang and sheds the audits' roughly 31 ms of blocking readback per packed round. The served path never uses the sampler output, so the tokens are the audits-off ones. Evidence, on image tp4-serve-6 (branch tp4/serve-4 at 300753b8) as the gate-only profile c2-packed-tp4-speed-strace: 5 of 5 audits-off passes of the deterministic hang (the diag twin); the engine-build hang shape passed (concurrent8_code); the S3a matrix gate (four users at 4,096 / 16,384 / 32,768 / 60,000 prompt tokens, 512 out) identical to solo, first run and rerun, POLICY PASS; about 23% more four-user coding throughput than this profile had with the audits on. The tail caps are on (QWEN_FAST_BUDGET_CAP=1: a round with more than one user stays packed until a user finishes, a sequential step verifies at full width and the commit is capped at the remaining budget) with the sequential-step watchdog at 120 s (QWEN_FAST_SEQ_DEADLINE_S: a stalled step dumps its stacks instead of waiting silently); neither moves the device allocation sequence. Engine and limits are c2-packed's (prompts up to 123,136 with at least 8,192 tokens of answer room, output ceiling 16,384, default answer 8,192, four seats, 8,208 KV blocks, parser M). The attach is admitted by packed_any_admission only while packed_any_evidence_tp4.json records CB1, CB2a and CB2b as PASS at its pinned sha256; without that record it is refused (fail closed, no fallback) and only c2-packed-tp4-gate, which logs each missing piece as UNQUALIFIED, boots in a gate run. This profile's env is c2-packed-tp4-speed-strace's less its gate-only marker (QWEN_C2_GATE_PROFILE) and gate limits: production keeps prompts up to 123,136 with at least 8,192 tokens of answer room (the strace arm ran with 256 and no prompt cap).

c2-packed-tp4-gate.description: GATE ONLY (the first four-card S2 runs): the c2-packed stack on all four cards as one (1, 4) mesh (mesh_device P150x4, QWEN_FAST_TP=4): the four-card ring descriptor at two links (tp4_mesh: 2x2), FABRIC_1D with the model's own Ring collectives, the fast path's own collectives at Linear until the fabric probe says otherwise (QWEN_FAST_CCL_TOPOLOGY, mesh_link_policy), QWEN_PROJECTION_LINKS=2 (two trained links per edge), the K64j extent program at ONE KV head per chip (QWEN_FAST_SDPA_MODES=tail,share: 0x23; the q-slice needs a second KV head) at G8B2, the packed GDN launch at 12 value heads on 48 cores, and no on-device sampler: the fast path verifies with its own shard argmax over 62,080 columns per chip (248,320 / 4). The image's other flags are the pair's (QWEN_FAST_TP is what makes the fast path read four-card widths, and serving_startup refuses a width the opened mesh does not have), except nine switched OFF because their code carries the pair's chip or head literals in text-patched, kernel or two-chip form that this port has not reached: the quad draft, the fused commit and its in-place / live-bank variants, the draft K/V slide, the traced publish's K/V fusion, the MLP block stream, the GDN direct-window and shared-QK experiments. The attach's own pair-only scopes are the four-card twins (attach_scopes_tp, rebound by tp_addresses at startup): the sampler's gather links at the ring's audited two, and the direct-window and K/V-publication scopes stand down (they patch nothing and refuse a profile that switches them on). The bring-up switches are general-tp4's: the fused prefill matmul + reduce-scatter off, the exact prefill conv audited beside the FIR for the first four chunks. NOT QUALIFIED: packed_any_evidence_tp4.json records no section, so the attach is refused by packed_any_admission except in a gate run (QWEN_C2_GATE=1), which logs each missing piece as UNQUALIFIED; the K64j extent program at one KV head, the GDN kernels at 12 heads, the drafter at 8 / 2 heads and the four-card collectives have not run on hardware. Engine, limits and gate behaviour are c2-packed-gate's (4 x 131,072, min_answer_tokens 256), with every audit on (verify T1 shard argmax against the pinned sampler, T2 windows; the proposal audit is off, it audits only eager proposals; the gate driver adds the extent audit): a correctness arm, never a timed one. Not for traffic: a 131072-token prompt leaves 256 tokens of answer. The drafter's K/V publication is the four-card slide (QWEN_FAST_TP_KV_SLIDE=1, draft_kv_slide_tp: the pair's kernel over 2 KV heads on 8 workers per chip) instead of the six-op eager chain, which built new programs every round while a prompt under 2,048 tokens filled its window; the eager chain stays behind the flag as the reference. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-gate-noslide.description: GATE ONLY (the speed window's A/B arm): c2-packed-tp4-gate with the drafter's K/V slide off (QWEN_FAST_TP_KV_SLIDE=0), so the publication is the six-op eager chain the S2 window's v140 ran. Every audit stays on, exactly as in the gate; the arm gives the byte-for-byte reference the slide's tokens are compared with and the ramp-commit time the slide removes. c2-packed-tp4-speed.description: GATE ONLY (the speed window's timed arm): c2-packed-tp4-gate with the verify's T1 shard-argmax and T2 window audits off (QWEN_FAST_VERIFY_T1_AUDIT=0, QWEN_FAST_VERIFY_T2_AUDIT=0), the drafter's K/V slide on. The audits cost about 31 ms of a packed round's readback (256 blocking reads per round for T2, one more for T1) and add work inside the verify trace, so c2-packed-tp4-gate cannot be timed; this arm is what the round time is read from, as the pair's timed arms ran with the audits off. The tokens are held against c2-packed-tp4-gate's on the same prompts (the audited arm). It carries the traffic profile's tail caps (QWEN_FAST_BUDGET_CAP=1, QWEN_FAST_SEQ_DEADLINE_S=120): the audits-off traffic shape that hung, with the caps that remove the narrow sequential steps. Every other flag and the engine are c2-packed-tp4-gate's. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-speed-fix.description: GATE ONLY (the fix arm of the audits-off hang): c2-packed-tp4-speed plus the capture plug (QWEN_FAST_CAPTURE_PLUG=1 and QWEN_FAST_CAPTURE_PLUG_ENGINES=1, sizes are PER BANK, not per chip (a p150a has 8 DRAM banks of about 4.24 GB; about 2.4 GiB per bank was free before the packed capture on v174): QWEN_FAST_CAPTURE_PLUG_LEAVE_MB=512 for the packed zone with QWEN_FAST_CAPTURE_PLUG_RESERVE_MB=256 above it, QWEN_FAST_CAPTURE_PLUG_ENGINE_LEAVE_MB=256 for each engine and QWEN_FAST_CAPTURE_PLUG_MIN_FREE_MB=128 as the floor on what the reserve above the packed zone has left, against the measured 224 MB per bank for the packed block, 168 MB per bank for its verify capture and 62 MB per bank for an engine. The verify audits stay OFF and the tail caps stay on. The hypothesis it tests is allocation aliasing: a buffer allocated after a trace capture lands in a hole the capture freed and a later replay rewrites it. The plug runs the packed captures inside a zone, plugs every hole they free with inert never-read tensors, and only then lets later allocations in below the zone; kernel binaries cannot enter the plugged zone (the allocation fails instead of overwriting) and a free-memory monitor refuses an engine when the free bytes above the packed zone drop under the floor. The graph census is off (QWEN_FAST_TRACE_CENSUS_GRAPH=0), so the evidence for the mechanism is the plug log lines and the sealed-hole tripwire, not recorded extents. QWEN_FAST_STALL_DEADLINE_S=120 and QWEN_FAST_CCL_HANDLE_GUARD=log (it logs the handles every trace baked and any collective that reuses the handle the previous op on its slot ended on with no fence between; the refusing mode, 1, can fail a request on patterns that run in every passing audited run, such as the proposal coordinator's back-to-back non-blocking replays, so it is not in this arm) are on. The tokens are held against c2-packed-tp4-gate on the same prompts; the round time is read against c2-packed-tp4-speed (the plug adds no device work to a round). Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-speed-sprewarm.description: GATE ONLY (the audits-off hang, sampler isolation arm): c2-packed-tp4-speed plus QWEN_FAST_PACKED_SAMPLER_PREWARM=1: the packed block's EAGER warm forward runs the pinned sampler once (exactly the T1 audit's sample_rows call: the sampler all-gather, untilize and ArgMax over 248,320 columns, two 32-row sample_tiles calls for 64 rows) before the verify capture and discards the result; the capture and every replay are the audits-off ones, with no extra op in the trace and no per-round readback or compare. The factorial that led here: both verify audits on passes, the T1 audit alone passes every hang shape, the T2 audit alone hangs, both off hangs; every hang is the host blocked in ttnn.execute_trace on the first replay of a request's rows=2 verify trace after many four-user packed rounds. This arm keeps the verify audits OFF (QWEN_FAST_VERIFY_T1_AUDIT=0, QWEN_FAST_VERIFY_T2_AUDIT=0), so tokens are the audits-off ones (the served path never uses the sampler output). The tail caps stay on (QWEN_FAST_BUDGET_CAP=1) and no instrument or stall watch is on, so the round time reads against c2-packed-tp4-speed for the arm's cost (the timing twin of the diag arm). Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

The factorial that led here: both verify audits on passes, the T1 audit alone passes every hang shape, the T2 audit alone hangs, both off hangs; every hang is the host blocked in ttnn.execute_trace on the first replay of a request's rows=2 verify trace after many four-user packed rounds. c2-packed-tp4-speed-strace-fcommit.description: GATE ONLY (the next-3 window, timed, pairs): c2-packed-tp4-speed-strace plus the fused commit at four cards: QWEN_FAST_FUSED_COMMIT=1, QWEN_FAST_FUSED_COMMIT_INPLACE=1 and QWEN_FAST_FUSED_COMMIT_LIVE_BANKS=1 (the pair draft, QWEN_FAST_QUAD_DRAFT=0). Each packed user's drafter K/V publication - the eager projection, the ten slide dispatches and the fence, about 466 enqueued ops a four-user round in the four-card device profile - becomes one captured T_proj trace per segment and, in place, one captured slide trace per (segment, accepted prefix) (docs/tp4-traced-publish.md, docs/tp4-fused-commit.md). It is the production recipe (audits off, the pinned sampler recorded in the verify trace, the tail caps) with that one lever, so the timed pair against c2-packed-tp4-speed-strace differs in the three fused-commit flags alone, and it keeps the trace shape the audits-off hang fix depends on only if the extra captures leave the allocation sequence alone: that is what its hang-shape repeats decide. NOT QUALIFIED on hardware: the fused commit is exact on the one card at two KV heads (the tp4-fcommit CPU proofs and the card M runs) but has never been timed, and never run with the in-trace sampler. No fused-commit audit and no verify audit: the tokens are held against the audited c2-packed-tp4-gate-fcommit arm's. Gate only: it carries the gate waiver's marker and is never a production profile.

c2-packed-tp4-diag.description: GATE ONLY (hang diagnosis): c2-packed-tp4-speed as it was before the tail caps - the environment of the direct smoke SS v164 (the verify audits off; v164 ran the traffic profile, so QWEN_C2_GATE_PROFILE=1 here only waives the traffic checks on these prompts and budgets) - with the caps OFF (QWEN_FAST_BUDGET_CAP=0: the old tail narrowing, so the packed-to-sequential transition that hung is reproduced) and the hang instruments on: the sequential-step watchdog (QWEN_FAST_SEQ_DEADLINE_S=120), the stage markers (QWEN_FAST_SEQ_STAGE_LOG), the first-replay trace census (QWEN_FAST_TRACE_CENSUS), the collectives handle log (QWEN_FAST_CCL_HANDLE_LOG) and the L1 allocator view (QWEN_FAST_MEMORY_LEDGER_L1). Every instrument is host-only, so the device allocation sequence is v164's. The graph census is OFF (QWEN_FAST_TRACE_CENSUS_GRAPH=0: the ttnn.graph capture reads every tensor argument and the capture refuses reads, which killed v173 at attach, so no diag profile turns it on). The stall watch (QWEN_FAST_STALL_DEADLINE_S=120) covers sequential steps, packed rounds, engine builds and prefill segments: on a stall every thread stack is dumped without ending the process, the pinned tt-metal triage tools (dump_running_operations, dump_callstacks, check_binary_integrity, check_noc_status, dump_fast_dispatch, check_eth_status) read the hung mesh, and only then is the process ended. QWEN_FAST_CCL_HANDLE_GUARD=log logs the handles every trace baked and any unfenced same-handle collective. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-f2.description: GATE ONLY (the admission-freeze window's F2 arm): c2-packed-tp4 with the admission diagnostics trimmed (QWEN_FAST_ADMISSION_DIAG_TRIM=1). The per-admission memory-ledger points (prefill before and after, the engine's before point and walk) are taken for the first admission only, the GDN slot adoption reads the conv slices back at each slot's first adoption only (its metadata checks stay on every adoption), and the 'dram after engine' line is off. The measured components come to about 0.35 to 0.55 s per admission, all inside the freeze in which no live user decodes, but the full saving applies only from the second adoption of each slot onward: in the first burst after a boot, slots 1 to 3 are first adoptions and still pay the 0.2 to 0.28 s readback, so expect roughly the ledger and dram-line share (about 0.25 to 0.3 s for each admission after the first). The per-admission phase markers ('[MEMLEDGER] phase=prefill point=after req=', '[PINDIAG] dram after engine') are in the log for the first admission only, so measure TTFT and decode on the client side and take the freeze length from the prefill-gate lines. Everything else, the verify audits, the tail caps and the engine, is c2-packed-tp4's, so a speed comparison against it is attributable to the flag. It carries the admission waiver (QWEN_C2_GATE_PROFILE=1) as every gate-only twin does and never serves traffic; the traffic profile keeps the full ledger until this arm is measured.

c2-packed-tp4-f12.description: GATE ONLY (the admission-freeze window's F1 + F2 arm): c2-packed-tp4-f2 with the decode credit on (QWEN_FAST_DECODE_STEPS_PER_ADMISSION=1, lever N's alternation in serving_prefill_admission). After each admission the running decodes are owed one decode-only step before the next fresh prompt is let in, so the users admitted first decode while the later arrivals of a burst are admitted, instead of waiting out the whole freeze. The credit moves time from the later users' first token (about one decode round, 150 to 200 ms, per earlier admission) to the earlier users' decode, and is exactness-neutral by design (it changes scheduling order only) but UNVERIFIED on hardware: it runs decode rounds with 1 to 3 live users mid-burst, so judge this arm real-text exact against solo, as every TP4 arm is. It is armed by an admission, paid by any decode-only pass after it, and dropped when nothing is waiting, no decode runs or a partial prefill is in flight, so a lone arrival is admitted at once. The F2 flag (QWEN_FAST_ADMISSION_DIAG_TRIM=1) is on as in c2-packed-tp4-f2, so the per-admission phase markers are missing after the first admission, as in c2-packed-tp4-f2, and this arm against it isolates the credit and against c2-packed-tp4 measures both. It carries the admission waiver (QWEN_C2_GATE_PROFILE=1) and never serves traffic.

general-2link.description: general on the pair at the two links this cabling trains: the TP2 reference and baseline for the TP4 jobs (J2r agreement, J3r benchmark). general itself pins upstream's p150_x2 descriptor, which declares four channels per edge; the TT plugin's default fabric reliability, STRICT_INIT, refuses an open whose edge trained fewer links than declared (control_plane.cpp), and M-A trains two, so general cannot open on this cabling. This profile is general with mesh_device P300 (the image's own pair MESH_DEVICE, tt_ccl's table gives it 2 links) under a two-channel 1x2 descriptor (tp4_mesh.pair_descriptor_text). Same engine, context, seats and environment as general; a bring-up profile for the reference, not the fast path (the contract refuses qwen_fast_t16 under it). UNVERIFIED on hardware until J2r opens it.

general-prefix.description: general with conversation prefix reuse (the TT prefix-reuse design, G1): vLLM's attention prefix cache plus GDN checkpoints the model saves at 2048-token boundaries, so a turn that extends an earlier prompt re-prefills only from the last checkpoint below its vLLM hit, byte-identical to a cold prefill. Exactly general's engine argv with enable-prefix-caching and enable-chunked-prefill in place of the no- flags (the argv the P0a probe built and passed): vLLM's align-mode assertion needs chunking on, and the TT platform turns chunking off again for qwen3_5 and raises max-num-batched-tokens to max-model-len, so prefill stays whole-prompt. QWEN_PREFIX_REUSE=1 switches every prefix-reuse graft in the image on (the model's supports_prefix_caching, the scheduler graft, the runner patch); QWEN_PREFIX_STORE_GIB is the host checkpoint budget (about 154 MB per checkpoint; design D-P4). Hits need a cache_salt the platform minted: the API server drops any cache_salt that does not verify against the salt key in /models/.qwen-c2/prefix-salt.key (serving_c2_contract.salt_verdict), so without that key no request hits and the profile serves as general does (fail closed; the ADM gateway must mint salts first, design 2.2 need 4). prefix-caching-hash-algo is pinned to sha256, vLLM's default. The runtime kill switch is the file /models/.qwen-c2/prefix-reuse.off. Needs an image whose prefix stage grafted every target (/opt/qwen-c2/prefix-stage.json complete=true); without it the platform drops prefix caching and vLLM refuses to start. Not the default: UNVERIFIED on hardware until the G1 gates pass.

general-prefix-eager.description: GATE ONLY (G1's eager exactness gate, design F1): general-prefix with trace_mode decode_only, so prefill takes the eager chunk loop - the loop C1 reuses on the fast path - instead of the traced one. Everything else is general-prefix's. Not for traffic: the eager prefill is slower, and gate_only makes the contract refuse to boot it without QWEN_C2_GATE=1.

general-tp4.description: general at TP4, 8 seats x 65,536: All four p150a cards as one (1, 4) mesh (mesh_device P150x4, TP4): the four-card ring descriptor (tp4_mesh: 2x2, 2 channels), FABRIC_1D (the plugin default, stated) with the model's own Ring collectives at 2 links (tt_ccl P150x4), the ring check at mesh open, and on-device sampling for decode (sample_on_device_mode decode_only: 248,320 / 4 = 62,080 logits per device fits the sampler; the TT plugin falls back to host sampling per batch for min_p, logit_bias, bad_words, any logprobs request (at four devices the fixture refuses device sampling for a batch with a logprobs request) and the like, and /models/.qwen-c2/device-sampling.off or QWEN_HOST_SAMPLING=1 drops it for every batch). The image's model graft and kernels are TP-generic (per-device widths from tp = 4); the GDN kernels were qualified at 24 value heads per chip and run 12 here. KV per chip at TP4 is one KV head: 16 attention layers x (K, V) x 1 head x 256 x 1.0625 B (bf8, QWEN_SDPA_BF8=1) = 8,704 B per token, half the pair's 17,408 (4 x 131,328 held 9.149 GB per chip at TP2, four-streams feasibility doc). Per chip: weights ~7.4 GB (27.49 GiB / 4), non-weight non-KV <= 6.9 GB (the TP2 plain path's bound 21.69 - 14.8, assumed not to shrink), so ~14.3 GB before KV of the ~33.9 GB each chip allocates. Pool 8 x 65,536 = 524,288 tokens = 4.56 GB per chip - the same KV per chip as general's 4 x 65,536 on the pair - leaving ~15 GB per chip free (d, until G5 at TP4 measures it). Twice general's seats; B = 8 fits the GDN core waves at TP4 (8 x 12 = 96 value heads of 110 cores). UNVERIFIED on hardware until the TP4 jobs pass (J2 smoke and agreement, J3 benchmark). TP4 bring-up switches (env): QWEN_GDN_PREFILL_MMRS=0 keeps the fused matmul + reduce-scatter prefill out-projection off (it deadlocked on the pair and has never run at four devices; the general-tp4-mmrs profile is its dedicated arm), and QWEN_FAST_GDN_PREFILL_CONV_AUDIT=4 runs the exact prefill conv beside the FIR for the first four chunks at C = 2560, kd = 512 (a shape that has never run on hardware) and stops the engine on a byte mismatch; drop it once J2 passes.

c2-packed-tp4-speed-vglue.description: GATE ONLY (the vglue window's timed arm): c2-packed-tp4-speed with all five verify-glue levers on. c2-packed-tp4-best.description: GATE ONLY (the combined best, timed): c2-packed-tp4-speed (the verify audits off, the K/V slide, the traffic profile's tail caps QWEN_FAST_BUDGET_CAP=1 and QWEN_FAST_SEQ_DEADLINE_S=120) with the quad draft on (QWEN_FAST_QUAD_DRAFT=1), the fused commit in place on live banks (QWEN_FAST_FUSED_COMMIT, _INPLACE, _LIVE_BANKS) and all five verify-glue levers on (QWEN_FAST_TP4_COMMIT_LANES, _SHARD_VALUES, _GDN_GLUE, _GDN_BLOCK_CONV, _ATTN_FOLD). Nothing else differs from c2-packed-tp4-speed, so c2-packed-tp4-speed is its paired timing control (the levers are the only difference); the old tp4/next control c2-packed-tp4-time-gate lacks the tail caps. It does NOT carry the capture plug, the stall watch or the handle guard (c2-packed-tp4-speed-fix's arm): the audits-off hang fix that passes on hardware is added to it before the timing window. tp4/next-2 = tp4/serve-4 (the tail caps, the capture plug and stall watch, the repaired trace census, the two sampler arms) merged with tp4/next (the speed slide, per-tile exact collectives, the quad twin, the prefill-before-capture warm, the TP4 fused commit in place on live banks, and the five verify-glue levers C1a, V4a, V2, V1, V3a). Every lever is its own flag, each byte-identical to the path it replaces, so the flags compose; the attach's prefill warm runs before every packed and fused-commit trace capture. The lone-user lanes (QWEN_FAST_SOLO_LANE, QWEN_FAST_LANE) are NOT in this profile: serving_solo_lane refuses QWEN_FAST_FUSED_COMMIT (the fused commit is built for the M3 block alone), so the lanes stay on their own profiles. Not for traffic. NOT QUALIFIED: UNVERIFIED on hardware as a combination (each part has its own card evidence).

c2-packed-tp4-best-strace.description: GATE ONLY (the combined best, timed, with a hang fix): c2-packed-tp4-best plus QWEN_FAST_PACKED_SAMPLER_IN_TRACE=1, nothing else: the packed verify capture also records the pinned sampler ops exactly as the T1 audit does, and every packed replay runs the sampler gathers, but the output is never read back or compared (hang fix A; the timing twin of c2-packed-tp4-speed-strace). Why it exists: with the verify audits OFF and no hang fix the request engine deadlocks deterministically after a long sampler-free packed phase (seen on tp4-serve-6: the first rows=2 sequential replay, and a request engine build after many packed rounds), so every timed audits-off profile must carry a hang fix. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware as a combination. Pair it with its speed twin (c2-packed-tp4-speed-strace) on the same image: the levers are the only difference.

c2-packed-tp4-best-dbf16.description: GATE ONLY (the combined best, timed, drafter in bfloat16): c2-packed-tp4-best-strace plus QWEN_FAST_DRAFTER_BF16=1 and nothing else (tp4/drafter-bf16): every drafter projection (five layers q/k/v/o, gate/up/down, and the fc feature projection, 36 tensors) uploads as bfloat16 instead of the image-baked bfloat8_b. Costs the drafter about twice the weight bytes per pass; the lever pays only if the committed tokens per round rise by more than the extra drafter time. Pair it with c2-packed-tp4-best-strace on the same image (ABAB, paired per round); the proposals change, the verified text must not. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-best-samp.description: GATE ONLY (timing twin, tp4/samp-draft lever S1): c2-packed-tp4-best-strace plus QWEN_FAST_TP4_SHARD_ARGMAX=1 and nothing else: the per-shard argmax of every verify (the packed block, the lone-user lane and the request engines all call verify_trace_t1.sample_shards) runs as one tile-native scan launch on 110 cores plus a one-core fold, instead of untilize + ArgMax (940 us) + the V4a gather. Exact: the same first-index-of-the-maximum ids as today's for every row without a NaN. The in-trace pinned sampler (hang fix A) stays as it is. Marker lines: '[PINDIAG] tp4 shard argmax engaged' (proof it ran) and '[PINDIAG] tp4 shard argmax fell back' (the served path ran: the timing is then not the lever's). Pair it with its control c2-packed-tp4-best-strace on the same image, ABAB, judged per round. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-best-d2.description: GATE ONLY (timing twin, tp4/samp-draft levers D2a and D2c): c2-packed-tp4-best-strace plus QWEN_FAST_TP4_DRAFT_CONV=1 and QWEN_FAST_TP4_DRAFT_HEADS=1 and nothing else. D2a: the drafter's fused convolution (20 launches a pass, the largest drafter item) builds each page's seven-tile input with word copies and writes its output from the second data-movement core, in front of the served compute kernel: byte-identical tiles. D2c: the drafter's head split and merge (one core each) are one multi-core tile-copy launch each: byte-identical tiles. Both change nothing the drafter proposes, so tau must be identical (proved offline by the proposal-identity compare, speed_window_compare exit 0, and read per arm with tp4_samp_draft_report). Marker lines: '[PINDIAG] tp4 draft conv engaged' and '[PINDIAG] tp4 draft heads engaged' (proof they ran) and the matching 'fell back' lines (the served ops ran: the timing is then not the lever's). Pair it with c2-packed-tp4-best-strace on the same image, ABAB, judged per round. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-best-gate.description: GATE ONLY (the combined best, audited): c2-packed-tp4-gate-fcommit-quad (the verify audits, the fused-commit audit and the singles audit on; the quad on live banks, the fused commit in place) with the traffic profile's tail caps (QWEN_FAST_BUDGET_CAP=1, QWEN_FAST_SEQ_DEADLINE_S=120: the same caps as c2-packed-tp4-best, so the two arms schedule the same rounds) and all five verify-glue levers on and QWEN_FAST_TP4_VGLUE_AUDIT=1. Equivalently: c2-packed-tp4 (audits on) with the gate switches, the fused commit, the quad and the levers with their audits. A correctness arm, never a timed one; the tokens are held against c2-packed-tp4-best's. tp4/next-2 = tp4/serve-4 (the tail caps, the capture plug and stall watch, the repaired trace census, the two sampler arms) merged with tp4/next (the speed slide, per-tile exact collectives, the quad twin, the prefill-before-capture warm, the TP4 fused commit in place on live banks, and the five verify-glue levers C1a, V4a, V2, V1, V3a). The lone-user lanes (QWEN_FAST_SOLO_LANE, QWEN_FAST_LANE) are NOT in this profile: serving_solo_lane refuses QWEN_FAST_FUSED_COMMIT (the fused commit is built for the M3 block alone), so the lanes stay on their own profiles. Not for traffic. NOT QUALIFIED: UNVERIFIED on hardware as a combination (each part has its own card evidence).

c2-packed-tp4-best-gate-dbf16.description: GATE ONLY (the combined best, audited, drafter in bfloat16): c2-packed-tp4-best-gate plus QWEN_FAST_DRAFTER_BF16=1 and nothing else (tp4/drafter-bf16; audited twin of c2-packed-tp4-best-dbf16). Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-8-best-quad-dbf16.description: GATE ONLY (eight seats, two quad drafts, drafter in bfloat16; tp4/drafter-bf16): c2-packed-tp4-8-best-quad plus QWEN_FAST_DRAFTER_BF16=1 and nothing else: every drafter projection uploads as bfloat16 instead of the image-baked bfloat8_b, and each round runs two drafter passes (one per 64-row quad block), about 1.9 ms of extra weight read. Pair it with c2-packed-tp4-8-best-quad on the same image (ABAB, paired per round); the proposals change, the verified text must not. 131k windows: the bf16 weights add about 405 MB per chip, so an attach refusal is a finding. NOT the 8x262k twin: that pool sits at the high-band edge and needs num-gpu-blocks-override 19,200 and QWEN36_MAX_TOKENS_ALL_USERS 1,228,288 (docs/tp4-drafter-bf16.md). Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-best-gate-samp.description: GATE ONLY (audited arm of tp4/samp-draft lever S1): c2-packed-tp4-best-gate (every verify audit on, the quad, the fused commit and the five verify-glue levers with their audits) plus QWEN_FAST_TP4_SHARD_ARGMAX=1 and QWEN_FAST_TP4_SHARD_ARGMAX_AUDIT=1. Today's untilize / argmax / value path runs beside the kernels in every verify capture, and every round compares every row of every chip (ids exactly, values as numbers): '[PINDIAG] tp4 shard argmax audit N exact=True'. The T1 audit (the combined ids against the pinned sampler, every row) runs too. A correctness arm, never a timed one; the tokens are held against c2-packed-tp4-best-gate's. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-best-gate-d2.description: GATE ONLY (audited arm of tp4/samp-draft levers D2a and D2c): c2-packed-tp4-best-gate plus QWEN_FAST_TP4_DRAFT_CONV=1, QWEN_FAST_TP4_DRAFT_HEADS=1, QWEN_FAST_TP4_DRAFT_CONV_AUDIT=1 and QWEN_FAST_TP4_DRAFT_HEADS_AUDIT=1. Inside each drafter bucket's capture (the first two buckets of each of the single, pair and quad sites) every engaged drafter conv also runs the served I/O kernel and every engaged head split/merge also runs the served ops, on the same operands; the pairs are byte-compared on every chip right after that bucket's own replays (its build replay and its first real rounds), before any verify or commit replay can overwrite them: '[PINDIAG] tp4 draft conv audit exact=True convs=N' and '[PINDIAG] tp4 draft heads audit exact=True tensors=N'. The quad-against-singles audit (QWEN_FAST_DRAFT_SINGLES_AUDIT=all) and the T1/T2 audits run too. A correctness arm, never a timed one. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-diag-rshard.description: GATE ONLY (the audits-off hang, request-shard-argmax arm): c2-packed-tp4-diag plus QWEN_FAST_REQUEST_SHARD_ARGMAX=1. The request engine's rows=1/2/4 verify traces pick tokens with the packed block's per-chip shard argmax (verify_trace_t1.sample_shards, combined on the host by combine_shards: first occurrence in chip order, the pinned sampler's tie rule) instead of the pinned sampler, so they bake no sampler AllGather, untilize or ArgMax; the packed rounds are unchanged. It engages only where the sampler is the plain greedy force-argmax one (no penalties, log-probabilities or request seed) and the logits are the bf16 TILE vocab shard, else the pinned sampler runs as before and the reason is logged once; a '[PINDIAG] request shard argmax engaged' line marks each width. Hypothesis under test: the pinned sampler's AllGather baked into the rows=2 request-verify trace is the hazard behind the audits-off first-replay hang. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware. Audits stay OFF (QWEN_FAST_VERIFY_T1_AUDIT=0, QWEN_FAST_VERIFY_T2_AUDIT=0); the old tail (QWEN_FAST_BUDGET_CAP=0), the hang instruments, the stall watch and the handle guard are c2-packed-tp4-diag's.

c2-packed-tp4-diag-t1-rshard-audit.description: GATE ONLY (correctness arm of the request-shard-argmax lever on the hang shapes): c2-packed-tp4-diag-t1 (the old tail, QWEN_FAST_BUDGET_CAP=0, so the request engine's rows=1/2/4 verify traces are replayed by ordinary traffic; the verify T1 shard-argmax audit on and the T2 window audit off; the hang instruments, the stall watch and the handle guard) plus QWEN_FAST_REQUEST_SHARD_ARGMAX=1 and QWEN_FAST_REQUEST_SHARD_AUDIT=1. The request engine's rows=1/2/4 verify traces pick tokens with the packed block's per-chip shard argmax (verify_trace_t1.sample_shards, combined on the host by combine_shards: first occurrence in chip order, the pinned sampler's tie rule) instead of the pinned sampler; under the audit each request verify trace also runs the pinned sampler beside it, every row is compared on the host, a mismatch is logged ('[PINDIAG] request shard argmax audit mismatch') and the pinned sampler's ids are what is served, so this arm cannot change a token. A matching replay logs '[PINDIAG] request shard argmax audit exact=True rows=N' once per width, so rows 1, 2 and 4 each have to be seen. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-speed-rshard.description: GATE ONLY (timing arm of the request-shard-argmax lever): c2-packed-tp4-speed plus QWEN_FAST_REQUEST_SHARD_ARGMAX=1. The request engine's rows=1/2/4 verify traces pick tokens with the packed block's per-chip shard argmax (verify_trace_t1.sample_shards, combined on the host by combine_shards: first occurrence in chip order, the pinned sampler's tie rule) instead of the pinned sampler, so they bake no sampler AllGather, untilize or ArgMax; the packed rounds are unchanged. Hypothesis under test: the pinned sampler's AllGather baked into the rows=2 request-verify trace is the hazard behind the audits-off first-replay hang. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware. Audits OFF, the tail caps and the sequential-step watchdog are c2-packed-tp4-speed's; pair it with c2-packed-tp4-speed on the same image for the per-step cost of the readback against the removed sampler.

c2-packed-tp4-gate-rshard-audit.description: GATE ONLY (correctness arm of the request-shard-argmax lever): c2-packed-tp4 as it was before the audits-off fix (the audited shape: both verify audits stay ON, explicitly, and the packed sampler stays out of the trace because the T1 audit already records it; the tail caps) plus QWEN_FAST_REQUEST_SHARD_ARGMAX=1 and QWEN_FAST_REQUEST_SHARD_AUDIT=1. The request engine's rows=1/2/4 verify traces pick tokens with the packed block's per-chip shard argmax (verify_trace_t1.sample_shards, combined on the host by combine_shards: first occurrence in chip order, the pinned sampler's tie rule) instead of the pinned sampler, so they bake no sampler AllGather, untilize or ArgMax; the packed rounds are unchanged. It engages only where the sampler is the plain greedy force-argmax one (no penalties, log-probabilities or request seed) and the logits are the bf16 TILE vocab shard, else the pinned sampler runs as before and the reason is logged once; a '[PINDIAG] request shard argmax engaged' line marks each width. Hypothesis under test: the pinned sampler's AllGather baked into the rows=2 request-verify trace is the hazard behind the audits-off first-replay hang. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware. Under the audit each request verify trace also runs the pinned sampler beside the shard argmax; every row is compared on the host, a mismatch is logged ('[PINDIAG] request shard argmax audit mismatch') and the pinned sampler's ids are what is served, so this arm cannot change a token.

c2-packed-tp4-speed-strace-ring.description: GATE ONLY (timing twin, tp4/next-3-cheap lever V6): c2-packed-tp4-speed-strace under the ring fabric, and nothing else. The deltas are exactly two: the engine's fabric_config is FABRIC_1D_RING (the control's is FABRIC_1D) and the fast path's own collectives run at Ring (QWEN_FAST_CCL_TOPOLOGY=ring; its four-card default is Linear). The mesh descriptor is the control's own ring descriptor and the model's own collectives (the all-reduce's reduce-scatter and all-gather) already run Ring at the control, so what moves is the fabric's routing and the fast path's feature-projection and drafter gathers. Eager probe J0b measured the ring faster: all-gather 58 against 64 us, reduce-scatter 65 against 84 us per call. Exactness: the ring changes how a reduce-scatter adds its partials (the feature projection's reduce_scatter_minimal_async), so the drafter's feature rows can differ in the last bit and the proposals with them; the target verifies every draft, so the served text is expected equal, and the audited arm c2-packed-tp4-gate-ring (audits on, the same two deltas) is the exactness check. Pair it with its control c2-packed-tp4-speed-strace on the same image, ABAB, judged per round: the fabric is the only difference. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware as a timed arm.

c2-packed-tp4-speed-strace-draftwide.description: GATE ONLY (timing twin, tp4/next-3-cheap lever D2): c2-packed-tp4-speed-strace plus QWEN_FAST_TP4_DRAFT_WIDE=1 and nothing else: the drafter's hidden-width (5,120) RMS norms, which run on one or two cores interleaved (21 per pass, 0.94 ms of each of the two pair passes per round in the v170 profile), run width-sharded on 20 cores (draft_wide_tp). The drafter's head ops stay as they are. A drafter change never changes the served text (the target verifies every draft); it can change the proposals in the last bit of a norm statistic, so the check is the accepted-prefix comparison against the control and the [ACCEPT] mean (tau parity). Marker lines: '[PINDIAG] tp4 draft wide engaged' (proof it ran) and '[PINDIAG] tp4 draft wide fell back' (a norm took the plain call: the timing is then not the lever's). Pair it with its control c2-packed-tp4-speed-strace on the same image, ABAB, judged per round. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-best-v5.description: GATE ONLY (V5, timed): c2-packed-tp4-best (the combined best: the verify audits off, the K/V slide, the traffic profile tail caps, the quad draft, the fused commit in place on live banks and all five verify-glue levers) with the recurrence value split on (QWEN_FAST_GDN_SPLIT_V=2: the K5-A recurrence launch with each head value columns split over two cores, gdn_seq_block_split, bound through the tp_addresses twin seam). Nothing else differs from c2-packed-tp4-best, so c2-packed-tp4-best is its paired timing control. Needs the split build qualified (gdn_seq_block_split.QUALIFIED, committed only after the single-card byte gate passes at full scope): the image refuses an unqualified build at the first verify capture. Read the paired verify span per round; the engaged line "[PINDIAG] gdn split_v build split=2 users=U qualified=1" must be in the container log (the smoke check fails the arm without it). A gate profile, never traffic.

c2-packed-tp4-best-v5-gate.description: GATE ONLY (V5, audited): c2-packed-tp4-best-gate (the audited combined best) with the recurrence value split on (QWEN_FAST_GDN_SPLIT_V=2) and the K5-A audit on layers 0, 23 and 47 (QWEN_FAST_GDN_SEQ_BLOCK_AUDIT=0,23,47: the served launch runs beside the split launch on the same inputs, both compared after the replay on every chip; every line must read mismatches=0). A correctness arm, never a timed one. Needs the split build qualified; the engaged line must be in the container log.

c2-packed-tp4-speed-strace-v5.description: GATE ONLY (V5, timed, the production recipe): c2-packed-tp4-speed-strace (the verify audits off, the pinned sampler recorded in the verify trace, the traffic profile tail caps) with the recurrence value split on (QWEN_FAST_GDN_SPLIT_V=2, gdn_seq_block_split). Nothing else differs from c2-packed-tp4-speed-strace, so that profile is its paired timing control and its hang-shape twin: five consecutive completions of the audits-off hang shapes on this profile are the allocation-order evidence (the split launch adds one semaphore to the verify trace). Needs the split build qualified; the engaged line must be in the container log.

c2-packed-tp4-warm4-diag.description: GATE ONLY (four-seat hang proof): c2-packed-tp4's recipe with the in-trace sampler OFF (QWEN_FAST_PACKED_SAMPLER_IN_TRACE unset), the verify audits off, the production tail caps (QWEN_FAST_BUDGET_CAP=1: the engine-build form of the hang is what production meets) and the request-width warm ON (QWEN_FAST_M3_REQUEST_WARM=1: widths 1, 2, 4), with the hang instruments on (stage log, trace census with the graph census off, handle log and guard in log mode, L1 view, stall watch 120 s steps and 150 s builds). Equals c2-packed-tp4-diag with the cap set to 1, plus the build deadline and the warm. The request-width warm (QWEN_FAST_M3_REQUEST_WARM, request_width_warm) compiles and creates the any-request engine's rows 1/2/4 programs and state, and runs the pinned sampler once per width, BEFORE the process's first trace capture, so the first engine build after the single 64-row block's capture creates nothing the block's replays can overwrite (the eight-seat hang's mechanism, judged latent at four seats; confirmed at eight on hardware 2026-10-02). Branch tp4/warm4. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-warm4-control.description: GATE ONLY (the hanging control): c2-packed-tp4-warm4-diag with the warm OFF (QWEN_FAST_M3_REQUEST_WARM=0), one value apart. Expected to hang at the first engine build after a packed phase (the rows=2 warm-up fence); the stall watch names it. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-warm4-even-diag.description: GATE ONLY (the parity discriminator): c2-packed-tp4-warm4-diag with the warm at widths (1, 2, 4, 1) (QWEN_FAST_M3_REQUEST_WARM=even), which leaves the model and sampler CCL indices where they started (three widths flip both). A pass refutes handle phase as the mechanism; a hang means the plain warm cures by parity shift. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-warm4-gate.description: GATE ONLY (the exactness arm): c2-packed-tp4-gate (every audit on) plus the request-width warm (QWEN_FAST_M3_REQUEST_WARM=1) and nothing else. The T1 audit re-records the pinned sampler in the packed trace, so this arm proves exactness with the warm, not hang safety. Branch tp4/warm4. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-speed-warm4.description: GATE ONLY (the timed twin): c2-packed-tp4-speed-strace without the in-trace sampler plus the request-width warm; equivalently c2-packed-tp4-speed plus QWEN_FAST_M3_REQUEST_WARM=1. No instrument or stall watch is on. Read the round time against c2-packed-tp4-speed-strace (expected about 4 ms per round faster: the sampler's argmax/glue and collective leave the verify trace). Branch tp4/warm4. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-warm4-diag-oldtail.description: GATE ONLY (manual; the tail-replay form): c2-packed-tp4-diag (the tail caps OFF, the packed-to-sequential transition that hung SR v163 and SS v164 reproduced) plus the build deadline (QWEN_FAST_STALL_BUILD_S=150) and the request-width warm (QWEN_FAST_M3_REQUEST_WARM=1). Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-8.description: C2-packed-any at TP4, EIGHT-SEAT TRAFFIC profile (not the file default and not production today; the served default only of an image built with C2_BAKE_DEFAULT_PROFILE, the eight-seat ship variant): c2-packed-tp4 (the verified winning recipe: verify audits off, the pinned sampler recorded in the verify trace, the tail caps, 4 x 131,328 limits) plus exactly four deltas. Eight seats on TWO 64-row M3 blocks (QWEN_FAST_M3_BLOCKS=2: block A over pool slots 0-3, block B over 4-7, run back to back in one step, each block replaying the qualified 64-row programs; four draft pairs). (1) QWEN_FAST_M3_BLOCKS=2, implemented by the serving runtime; unset (the production profile) every path is the single-block one. (2) max-num-seqs 8. (3) num-gpu-blocks-override 16,416 = 8 x 2,052: every seat is fully reserved at 131,328 positions, so no reservation admission is needed and no request can outgrow the pool (the fast path cannot preempt). (4) trace_region_size 536,870,912 (512 MiB): two block traces, eight request engines and four pair traces need about 409 MB of trace region. Limits, prompts up to 123,136 with at least 8,192 tokens of answer room, and the attach admission (packed_any_admission, evidence unchanged: each block is the qualified 4-user geometry) are c2-packed-tp4's. UNVERIFIED on hardware: the two-block attach, mixed rounds and the audits-off hang shapes at eight users are what the seats8 window measures; c2-packed-tp4 stays the file default and the production profile until the W-S8 qualification passes and the owner ships the baked image.

c2-packed-tp4-8-gate.description: GATE ONLY (the eight-seat exactness arm, never for traffic): c2-packed-tp4-8 plus both verify audits on (QWEN_FAST_VERIFY_T1_AUDIT=1, QWEN_FAST_VERIFY_T2_AUDIT=1), the admission waiver marker (QWEN_C2_GATE_PROFILE=1), the gate limits (min_answer_tokens 256, no prompt cap) and gate_only. Eight seats on TWO 64-row M3 blocks (QWEN_FAST_M3_BLOCKS=2: block A over pool slots 0-3, block B over 4-7, run back to back in one step, each block replaying the qualified 64-row programs; four draft pairs). A correctness arm: the audits add a blocking readback per packed round, so it is never a timed one (c2-packed-tp4-8-time-gate is its audits-off twin). UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-8-time-gate.description: GATE ONLY (the eight-seat timed twin, never for traffic): c2-packed-tp4-8 with the admission waiver marker (QWEN_C2_GATE_PROFILE=1), the gate limits (min_answer_tokens 256, no prompt cap) and gate_only; the verify audits stay OFF and the sampler stays in the verify trace, so its rounds are the traffic profile's. Eight seats on TWO 64-row M3 blocks (QWEN_FAST_M3_BLOCKS=2: block A over pool slots 0-3, block B over 4-7, run back to back in one step, each block replaying the qualified 64-row programs; four draft pairs). It is the audits-off arm for the paired timing against c2-packed-tp4-time-gate (four seats) and for the audits-off hang shapes at eight users. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-8-best.description: GATE ONLY (the eight-seat best-levers arm, never for traffic; tp4/next-4): c2-packed-tp4-8-time-gate (eight seats on two 64-row M3 blocks, the request warm, the in-trace sampler, the waiver marker, the gate limits, gate_only) plus the nine best levers (the quad draft, the fused commit in place on live banks, the five verify-glue levers). It asks whether the round levers that gave +39-42% at four seats compose with two blocks at eight; its paired control is c2-packed-tp4-8-time-gate (the nine levers are the only difference). Untested on hardware: an attach refusal here is a finding, not a defect of the arm.

c2-packed-tp4-8-best-quad.description: GATE ONLY (the eight-seat quad arm, never for traffic; tp4/next-5): c2-packed-tp4-8-best plus QWEN_FAST_QUAD_DRAFT_BLOCKS=2, which gives each block of four seats its own 64-row quad draft, (0, 1, 2, 3) and (4, 5, 6, 7), instead of the pair drafts the eight-seat pool runs today (the quad draft flag the base already names forms no quad beyond four seats). Its paired control is c2-packed-tp4-8-best (the blocks flag is the only difference). The smoke expects two quad engaged markers, one per block, and a round both quads served, in concurrent8_steady. Untested on hardware: an attach refusal here is a finding, not a defect of the arm. Both quads can share a round only while the hook makes one prepare call for the whole step: with QWEN_FAST_PAIRS_PACKED_ONLY set and one block packed, the calls split and a both-quads round never forms. The blocks flag needs QWEN_FAST_EXTENT_REPLAY=1 and QWEN_FAST_PACKED_PROPOSAL=1 (the attach refuses it otherwise).

c2-packed-tp4-8-diag-strace.description: GATE ONLY (the eight-seat audits-off hang arm, never for traffic): c2-packed-tp4-8-time-gate (audits off, the pinned sampler in the verify trace, the gate marker and limits) plus the host-only instruments of the hang diagnosis: the stall watch (QWEN_FAST_STALL_DEADLINE_S=120: a stalled step dumps the stuck work's stacks instead of waiting silently), the stage log and the allocator census (QWEN_FAST_SEQ_STAGE_LOG=1, QWEN_FAST_TRACE_CENSUS=1 with the graph off: the handle log prints only through the stage log, and the census shows where block B allocates around block A) and the collectives handle log (QWEN_FAST_CCL_HANDLE_LOG=1) and the handle guard in log mode (QWEN_FAST_CCL_HANDLE_GUARD=log). The audits-off hang was an eager collective reusing a handle a replayed trace baked, and two block traces on one shared model, sampler and collectives are a new exposure to exactly that; the in-trace sampler fix is proven only at four users. Eight seats on TWO 64-row M3 blocks (QWEN_FAST_M3_BLOCKS=2: block A over pool slots 0-3, block B over 4-7, run back to back in one step, each block replaying the qualified 64-row programs; four draft pairs). There is no qualified hang fallback at eight seats: the request-shard argmax arm and the capture plug are unqualified or do not fit the eight-seat memory. QWEN_FAST_M3_REQUEST_WARM=1 (every eight-seat profile carries it: without it the first request-engine build after block B's capture hangs at the rows=2 warm-up fence) compiles and creates the request engine's rows 1/2/4 state before either block captures, and QWEN_FAST_STALL_BUILD_S=150 shortens the build deadline from 600 s so a hang costs minutes. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-8-diag-strace-nowarm.description: GATE ONLY (the R2 control, never for traffic): c2-packed-tp4-8-diag-strace with QWEN_FAST_M3_REQUEST_WARM=0, so the request widths are NOT warmed before the captures. It must still hang at the rows=2 warm-up fence, or the warm-up's pass proves nothing. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-8-diag-strace-rshard.description: GATE ONLY (the R3 discriminator, never for traffic): c2-packed-tp4-8-diag-strace plus the request-shard argmax arm (QWEN_FAST_REQUEST_SHARD_ARGMAX=1) and its audit (QWEN_FAST_REQUEST_SHARD_AUDIT=1): the request engine's rows 1/2/4 verify traces pick the token with the shard argmax instead of the pinned sampler. Run only if the diag arm hangs at the same fence, to tell the sampler path from the model path. Never run on hardware before. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

c2-packed-tp4-best-strace-tpub.description: GATE ONLY (the combined best, timed, with the sequential step's carry copies traced): c2-packed-tp4-best-strace plus QWEN_FAST_TP4_TRACED_PUBLISH=1, nothing else. The lone-user (sequential) step's GDN carry save, and the restore a resident-engine switch pays, replay one captured trace each instead of 48 eager launches (16.4 ms median host enqueue a step, run N4b); the traces are captured inside the request engine's own build, after its verify and commit traces, from carry slots allocated at attach, with the copy kernels run eagerly once before the capture, so nothing persistent is created after a capture. The packed block's fused commit (QWEN_FAST_FUSED_COMMIT, already on in c2-packed-tp4-best) is the traced publication of the four-user round and is unchanged; the flag adds the same idea to the sequential path. Audits off, the in-trace sampler hang fix kept. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware. Pair it with c2-packed-tp4-best-strace on the same image: the one flag is the only difference.

c2-packed-tp4-best-gate-tpub.description: GATE ONLY (the combined best, audited, with the sequential step's carry copies traced): c2-packed-tp4-best-gate plus QWEN_FAST_TP4_TRACED_PUBLISH=1 and QWEN_FAST_TP4_TRACED_PUBLISH_AUDIT=1, nothing else. c2-packed-tp4-8x262k-best-levern-audit.description: GATE ONLY, UNQUALIFIED (the 262k evidence waiver, as its base carries it). Lever N at TP4 (docs/lever-n-tp4-design-2026-10-04.md): a long prefill is split into steps that each end on the model's own 2,048-token chunk boundary and decode rounds run between them, so the seats that are decoding are not frozen for a whole cold prefill (about 92 s of prefill and about 2 s of engine build for one cold 253,920-token prompt today). The engine runs enable-chunked-prefill with max-num-batched-tokens equal to max-model-len, so nothing splits except through the scheduler cap (levern_scheduler); the TT platform's policy that turns chunking off is wrapped (levern_platform); the lifecycle announces each step and the model route (levern_route) continues its own suspended GDN scratch from the exact chunk boundary the previous step ended on, writes the decode slot only on the final step and refuses a foreign owner before any device work. c2-packed-tp4-8x262k-ship.description: The ship-shaped eight-seat 262k traffic candidate (NOT gate_only; tp4/262k8; for later, after the 8x262k-best window passes its ladder, hang shapes and timed pairs): c2-packed-tp4-8x262k (production limits: max_prompt_tokens 253,920, min_answer_tokens 8,192, no waiver marker, audits off, the in-trace sampler) plus the nine best levers of c2-packed-tp4-best-strace that two 64-row blocks serve (the quad draft, the fused commit in place on live banks, the five verify-glue levers: QWEN_FAST_QUAD_DRAFT, QWEN_FAST_FUSED_COMMIT, QWEN_FAST_FUSED_COMMIT_INPLACE, QWEN_FAST_FUSED_COMMIT_LIVE_BANKS, QWEN_FAST_TP4_COMMIT_LANES, QWEN_FAST_TP4_SHARD_VALUES, QWEN_FAST_TP4_GDN_GLUE, QWEN_FAST_TP4_GDN_BLOCK_CONV, QWEN_FAST_TP4_ATTN_FOLD) and QWEN_FAST_QUAD_DRAFT_BLOCKS=2 (each block of four seats drafts as its own 64-row quad, instead of the pair passes). Every lever of c2-packed-tp4-best-strace is in; none refuses at two blocks (nothing is left out): the verify-glue levers refuse only at the pair (QWEN_FAST_TP below 4), the fused commit is built per block over that block's own pool slots and a block that cannot build it logs its refusal and serves today's publication, and the quad blocks refuse (by name, at the attach) only a pool that is not eight slots, a process without QWEN_FAST_EXTENT_REPLAY=1 and QWEN_FAST_PACKED_PROPOSAL=1 (the image sets the second; the profile the first), the quad audit flag and a non-four-card width. The request warm (QWEN_FAST_M3_REQUEST_WARM=1) and the in-trace sampler hang fix are the eight-seat family's own. KV POOL: 19968 blocks (num-gpu-blocks-override and QWEN36_MAX_TOKENS_ALL_USERS=1277440 = (19968 - 8) x 64, the pair the contract holds equal), 1,792 blocks (0.998 GB per chip, 114,688 tokens) fewer than c2-packed-tp4-8x262k's 21,760, because the levers add about 0.96 GB per chip that the 21,760-block pool's margin does not have at the design's high non-KV band: two quad captures at 450 MiB (943,718,400 bytes; quad_draft.QUAD_CAPTURE_BYTES_EST x 2, captured at the first round of each block and kept beside the pair traces) and the fused commit's tables and deltas for eight segments (8 x 344,064 bytes = 2,752,512; its T_proj temporaries are bounded at 16 MiB in all); the pool formula 16,416 + floor((F8 - 1.0 GB - 0.07 GB RoPE and transient growth) / 557,056 B), with F8 the free DRAM at eight live seats less the levers' 0.96 GB, gives 19,979 at the high band, 19,968 is the 64-aligned value below it. Five full 262,144-token windows no longer fit at once (5 x 4,097 reserved blocks = 20,485 > 19,967): four do (4.87 windows of tokens); the reservation admission holds the rest. PROVISIONAL: the first card job that reads F8 with the levers on (the P1 profile job, the S0 smoke's memory ledger) re-sets it; 21,760 needs F8 of at least 4.05 GB with the levers in. Not for traffic until that window passes; the file default stays c2-packed-tp4.
